recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Financial Accounting for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: R. A. I. Kazeem
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Partnership Accounts: Profit and Loss Appropriation
subtopics: Partnership Act 1890 and the Partnership Deed provisions (profit sharing ratio, interest on capital, drawings)
Profit and Loss Appropriation Account: Distribution of net profit among partners
Partners' Capital Accounts (Fixed vs fluctuating capital methods) and Current Accounts
objectives: Explain clauses contained in a statutory Partnership Deed
Prepare a Profit and Loss Appropriation Account calculating interest on capital and drawings
Construct Partners' Current Accounts in columnar ledger format

topics.topic: Admission and Retirement of a Partner: Goodwill Valuation
subtopics: Revaluation of assets and liabilities upon admission or retirement of a partner
Goodwill in partnership: Meaning, causes, methods of valuation
Accounting treatment: Raising goodwill account, writing off goodwill through profit-sharing ratio
objectives: Prepare a Revaluation Account recording asset appreciation and depreciation
Calculate a new partner's capital contribution and premium for goodwill
Distribute revaluation profit or loss among existing partners

topics.topic: Company Accounts: Issue of Ordinary and Preference Shares
subtopics: Types of companies: Private vs public limited liability companies
Share capital structure: Authorized (nominal), issued, called-up, paid-up, calls in arrears
Accounting entries for issue of shares at par, at premium, and calls on allotment
objectives: Distinguish Ordinary Shares from Cumulative Preference Shares and Debentures
Pass ledger journal entries for share applications, allotments, and call monies
Record the Share Premium Account and its statutory capital uses under CAMA 2020

topics.topic: Financial Ratio Analysis and Performance Interpretation
subtopics: Profitability ratios: Gross profit margin, net profit margin, return on capital employed (ROCE)
Liquidity ratios: Current ratio, acid test (quick) ratio
Efficiency and leverage ratios: Inventory turnover period, debtors collection period, debt-to-equity ratio
objectives: Calculate profitability and liquidity ratios from final accounts data
Evaluate the financial health and solvency of a Nigerian enterprise using calculated ratios
State limitations of accounting ratios in assessing company performance
